question: How do I register for classes?
label: pass
answer:
Here's how to register for classes online through Banner Self-Service:

1. Log in to the myDESU homepage.
2. From your Student Profile page, click **Registration and Planning**. Or click the **Student Services** icon and select **Register Now**.
3. Select the term and click **Continue**.
4. Click in the Subject box to see the course list, enter your search criteria, and click **Search**.
5. When you find a section that fits your schedule, click **Add**. It will show as "Pending" in your course summary, a bit like a shopping cart. You can see how it fits with your schedule before you register.
6. To add more sections, click **Search Again** and repeat.
7. Click **Submit** in the course summary pane to process your changes.

If a class has a problem, a message will appear at the top right of the screen. If you get registration errors, request assistance. A success notice appears at the top right when your registration saves. You can also drop and waitlist classes from this same screen.

**Non-degree students:** There is a mail-in option. Complete the PDF registration form and email it to registrar@desu.edu, or fax or mail it to the Office of Records & Registration. Tuition and fees are due at the time of registration. Details are here: https://www.desu.edu/admissions/office-records-registration

The Banner Self-Service guide was last updated in June 2024, so menu names may have changed. If something looks different, contact the Office of Records & Registration.

Full guide: https://www.desu.edu/about/administration/information-technology/banner-self-service-9-user-guide/registration-planning
